lines.say: That burn on your last rep? Everyone blames lactic acid.
Scientists say that's one of the biggest myths in fitness.
When you push hard, your muscles burn sugar so fast that by-products pile up.
The burn comes from acid, hydrogen ions, building up inside the muscle.
Lactate is just at the scene of the crime. It's actually fuel.
It leaves the muscle, rides your blood, and your heart, brain and liver burn it for energy.
And it's mostly gone within about an hour after you stop.
So it can't be why you're sore two days later.
Lactate isn't the villain. It's your backup battery.
